cov:edgarSubmission.cov:taStatementAboutAmendment: This is a Material Amendment to the ATS-N filed for the Blue Ocean ATS ("BOATS") in relation to the change in clearing firms from Velox Clearing LLC (NSCC#3856) to RQD* Clearing, LLC (NSCC#4305). This Material Amendment reflects changes to Part II Item 6b, Part III Item 2b, Part III Item 22a. These changes apply to all Subscribers and to the broker-dealer operator.
